issues.on_page: County Receipts 17,416 (all of it is GF 2110 County Fines and Licenses, p7)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-21: recategorized to fines and forfeitures (code 2110)] The statement line is entirely code 2110. The extractor rules make 2110 fines and forfeitures, and detail[10] already uses fines and forfeitures for the same money. Per the broad-line rule (use the category that is more than half of the line), this should be 'fines and forfeitures'.

issues.on_page: State Receipts 3,980,182 includes 3133 Nameplate Capacity Tax 348,001 (GF p7) + 29,294 (Special Building p12) = 377,295
issues.issue: Nameplate capacity tax (about 9.5% of the line) is 'other taxes' under the rules, and the fund schedules print its breakdown, so a split_from split would be allowed. Keeping the line whole is defensible because state aid is the dominant category. The line is already marked review.
Category guess. Postsecondary (dual-credit) receipts could be 'tuition and fees'. Already marked review.
Label mismatch: the extractor added the section heading to the printed label.

issues.on_page: 2620 Maintenance of Buildings 17,879 (function code, no object breakdown)
issues.issue: This is a function line with no object breakdown, so the rules point to 'not itemized'. That is how the same 2620 line is treated in the General Fund. 'repairs and maintenance' is plausible but inconsistent.

issues.on_page: budget printed only on schedule totals (e.g. GF receipts 6,402,493, disbursements 9,026,344)
issues.issue: The schema expects budget_final (null when not shown). The key is missing entirely instead of set to null. The printed budget totals are not recorded anywhere.

issues.on_page: Statement of Activities: Property 2,935,565; governmental funds statement p5: 2,935,566
issues.issue: The report's two statements differ by $1 (printed rounding). This is not recorded in report_discrepancies. The extracted figure correctly follows the funds statement.
